text: InAppNotification sets attributes from backend values, so JavaScript null and undefined can become the strings "null" and "undefined". The container deliberately hides its CTA for either string and for an absent value; the current browser test covers actual null, actual undefined, their string forms and removal. By contrast, the URL branch removes href only for an absent or empty value and otherwise passes the value through the URL formatter. Manual boundary proposal in this component: document and test the absence policy per attribute instead of assuming all optional values remain JavaScript null. The CTA compatibility behavior is local, not a general rule to encode missing data as strings. A missing-URL payload test was not established by this source pass.
title: Optional notification CTA values need an attribute-boundary policy
